fees.source: https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/services-1 (Summer May 1 - October 31 'Daily (6 nights or less) $83.35'; Shoulder November and April Standard $85.05 to Lux Lake Plus $134.51; Peak December 1 - March 31 Standard $117.60 to Lux Lake Plus $164.27; 'Tax NOT included'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/rental-information (every site type: '20-30–50 amp service', 'Water & Sewer') + https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/faq ('The rental price includes, electric, water, sewer, and wi-fi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 318 individually owned sites on 33 acres, not all for rent; most 30 ft wide by 100 ft long. Luxury Lakefront and Lakefront Plus sites are pull-in for Class A/C motorhomes; every other type is back-in. RVs must be 26 ft or longer and 10 years old or newer; no Class B; travel trailers May-October only.

sites.source: https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/faq ('We have 318 sites on 33 acres', 'Most sites are 30' wide, 100' long', 'Not all sites are available for rent') + https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/rental-information ('Class A or C motorhomes only (Pull in)', 'Back in only', 'ALL RV'S MUST BE 26FT OR LONGER', 'ALL RV'S MUST BE 10 YEARS OR YOUNGER IN AGE', 'NO CLASS B ANY TIME OF YEAR'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Laundry building with 14 washers, 16 dryers and 6 restrooms with showers; heated pool and spa, 8 pickleball courts, Tiki Bar mid-November to mid-April. Free Wi-Fi 'on most sites and in all the common areas'.

facilities.source: https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/resort-amenities-1 ('large laundry facility, 14 washing machines & 16 dryers', 'laundry building has accessible ramp & 6 restrooms with showers', 'free WiFi on most sites and in all the common areas') + https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/faq ('Gulf Waters does have a RV waste dumping station'), read 2026-10-21

note: Lot-ownership RV resort (a homeowners association) off Summerlin Rd near the Fort Myers Beach causeway that rents owners' sites by the night through the association office; lots are for sale. An RV that doesn't match its booking (type, length, age, condition) can be turned away at check-in without a refund; for short-notice stays, call the office. --Claude
summary: Operator's site: confirmed the posted daily rates ($83.35 summer to $164.27 peak, tax extra) and year-round rentals. Added 50-amp full hookups at every site, 318 sites (pull-in lakefront types, back-in elsewhere), showers/laundry/Wi-Fi/dump. Note trimmed of the travel-trailer season (now in sites.note). No minimum stay posted (daily = 6 nights or less).
flags: Criteria: the operator states 'ALL RV'S MUST BE 26FT OR LONGER' (https://www.gulfwatersrvresortfl.com/rental-information), so EKKO at 23 ft would be turned away ('NON-COMPLIANCE AT CHECK-IN WILL RESULT IN DENIED OCCUPANCY WITHOUT REFUND'). Also 'ALL RV'S MUST BE 10 YEARS OR YOUNGER IN AGE' and 'NO CLASS B ANY TIME OF YEAR'.

Long-stay tests: a self-managed HOA where 'All sites are individually owned' and 12+ lots are listed for sale ($150,000-$309,900, /ownership), and 'Not all sites are available for rent'. Nightly rates are posted and booked on Campspot year-round with no minimum, and the resort calls itself 'a transient Community', so nights do look sold to passing travellers.
